scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging pnpm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: 32-byte random string used to sign session cookies. **Generate one** with `openssl rand -base64 32` — never paste a guessable value or a placeholder.

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: Leave empty when deploying to `*.workers.dev`. Set only if you bind a [custom domain](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/routing/custom-domains/) to this Worker.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Vision-model API key for meal analysis. Get one at [openrouter.ai/keys](https://openrouter.ai/keys) — they give $1 free credit, which covers hundreds of meals.

DB.description: D1 database for accounts, meals, weights, profile history. Create new — the deploy command applies migrations automatically.

BUCKET.description: R2 bucket for meal photos. Create new — photos are written via authenticated Worker routes, never exposed publicly.
